saw_lines: Parents and players sign up for tournaments and clubs once a season, mostly because a coach or friend already plays there.
So the sign up is won or lost on the homepage, where the headlines speak to champions and calendars rather than a reason to register today.
Your site carries 2 customer quotes, yet 2 of your 4 Google creatives are plain text. Turn the pro career quote into the opening image or video of the next batch.
